_doc: The tutorial's animation chains (docs/expansion/15-Tutorial-The-Last-Normal-Night.md §5). Each step is a RoMixamo catalog clip ('Name | Description'), converted to the non-bending R6 rig. loop: a seamless loop the Cine holds until its cue; inplace: the torso's travel is removed (the Cine moves the actor); hold: the step freezes on its last frame (the cold open's freeze-frame). build.py picks the cut points and fades between steps and adds a bridge clip where two poses are too far apart.
